prediction_index.event: Completion of baseline MEC examination, proposed for later study-team confirmation
prediction_index.population: NHANES adults aged 65+ with MEC examination and eligible mortality follow-up

age.transformation: Numeric baseline age from RIDAGEYR; public-use participants aged 80+ are top-coded.
age.missing_semantics: No recode for missing; index and survey age conventions require review.
age.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.

sex.transformation: Categorical demographic field: raw codes 1=Male, 2=Female in processed source.
sex.missing_semantics: Missing/unknown codes not inferred; respect source dictionary.
sex.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.

bmi.transformation: Original numeric BMXBMI retained only if between 12 and 70 in current source function.
bmi.missing_semantics: Unobserved/filtered values become missing; distinguish no exam and out-of-range.
bmi.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.

walking_difficulty.transformation: PFQ 1-4 retained; raw code 5 set missing in processed file; PFQ054=1 can skip item.
walking_difficulty.missing_semantics: Raw 279 PFQ054 skips plus 24 code-5 nonperformance in development; proven only NHANES PFQ.
walking_difficulty.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.

stairs_difficulty.transformation: PFQ 1-4 retained; code 5 filtered; PFQ054=1 can skip item by questionnaire design.
stairs_difficulty.missing_semantics: Raw 279 PFQ054 skips plus 13 code-5 nonperformance in development.
stairs_difficulty.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.

stooping_difficulty.transformation: PFQ 1-4 retained; raw code 5 filtered. The B/C skip does not apply to D.
stooping_difficulty.missing_semantics: 35 code-5 nonperformance values in development, zero B/C-style structural skip.
stooping_difficulty.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.

heart_failure.transformation: Raw 1=yes, 2=no; other values set missing by recode_yes_no.
heart_failure.missing_semantics: Refused, unknown and structurally inapplicable codes require source-specific review.
heart_failure.timing_rationale: The survey collection phase is known, but exact individual measurement timestamp, operational index and access at prediction time have not been verified.
